description: Ministry of Lands - Correction Notice to the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2273/38 dated 30.03.2022
categorisation: This gazette content is a correction notice specifically related to land acquisition. It references The Land Acquisition Act and provides a correction to the extent (area measurement) of a land lot. The entire notice deals with property/land matters, specifically the administrative correction of a land area measurement in an acquisition process, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
